bias.en: Turning bullish · back above all five averages, capped near $452–454
bias.zh: 转强 · 重回五条均线上方，$452–454 附近受阻

read.en: Rockwell rose 1.4% on Nov 3 to $446.38, trading between $443.89 and $454.13. It is above the rising 5-day ($443.6), 10-day ($437.6), 30-day ($435.8) and 200-day ($427.3) averages and just above the falling 100-day ($446.0). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27 and above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($420.97), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 11月3日上涨 1.4%，收于 $446.38，盘中区间 $443.89–454.13。股价位于上行的 5 日（$443.6）、10 日（$437.6）、30 日（$435.8）和 200 日均线（$427.3）上方，并略高于下行的 100 日均线（$446.0）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$420.97），RSI 为 57。

read.en: The close cleared $441.4–442.2 and edged above the 100-day; the $454.13 high topped the Oct 29 high before fading. Resistance is $452.4–454.1 (Oct 29 and Nov 3 highs), then $460 (Oct 5–6 highs) and $468 (Jun 3 high). Support is $443.6–446 (5 and 100-day, Nov 3 low), then $435.8–437.6 (30 and 10-day) and $427.2. A close above $454 would target $460; below $443.6, $436.
